Duties of the Marshal

It shall be the duty of the Marshal to arrest and bring before the Mayor all offenders of the laws of the State or Ordinances of the Town of Chipley, commit them to prison when required by the Mayor, execute all warrants issued by the Mayor, serve all summons and subpoenas for witnesses, suppress riots and rows, preserve the peace and exercise a vigilant supervision generally in said Town, and he shall perform such other duties a8 may be required of him by the Mayor and Council.
